description: Source code for STMPE1600 I2C-based GPIO driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration structures, and driver implementation functions.

methods.name: write_reg16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: read_reg16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: set_pin_dir
methods.description: Configures the direction and initial state of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: stmpe1600_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: stmpe1600_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits according to mask and value.

methods.name: stmpe1600_init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, verifies chip ID, and reads initial register states.
